item.title: Trump says US to get 30 million to 50 million barrels of oil from Venezuela at market price
item.description: CARACAS, Venezuela (AP) — President Donald Trump said Tuesday on his social media site that “Interim Authorities” in Venezuela would be selling 30 million to 50 million barrels of “High Quality” oil to the U.S. at its market price.

item.title: 'It hurts': Barrie educator pushes for different response to n-word
item.description: Contractor, who works at West Bayfield Elementary School, calls on Simcoe County District School Board to do more educating when racial slur is used by student

item.title: B.C. lawsuit alleges 3 former Denny's employees stole thousands in tips
Trump administration says it’s withholding social safety net money from 5 states over fraud concerns
item.description: President Donald Trump’s administration said Tuesday that it is withholding funding for programs that support needy families with children in five Democratic-led states over concerns about fraud.

item.title: Israel clears final hurdle to start settlement construction that would cut the West Bank in two
item.description: JERUSALEM (AP) — Israel has cleared the final hurdle before starting construction on a contentious settlement project near Jerusalem that would effectively cut the West Bank in two, according to a government tender.

item.title: Michael Reagan, the eldest son of President Ronald Reagan, dies at 80
item.description: LOS ANGELES (AP) — Michael Reagan, the eldest son of President Ronald Reagan and a conservative commentator, has died. He was 80.

item.title: CIA turncoat Aldrich Ames, who sold US secrets to the Soviets, dies in prison at 84
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — CIA turncoat Aldrich Ames, who betrayed Western intelligence assets to the Soviet Union and Russia in one of the most damaging intelligence breaches in U.S. history, has died in a Maryland prison. He was 84.

item.title: Canada co-signs pact to help secure Ukraine after an eventual peace deal
item.description: PARIS — Canada and Ukraine's other allies in the "coalition of the willing" signed a statement Tuesday pledging to help secure Ukraine from further Russian invasions if there is a viable peace deal.

item.title: Yemen anti-Houthi council expels separatist leader and says he faces treason charges
item.description: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates (AP) — A council fighting against Yemen’s Houthi rebels said Wednesday it had expelled the leader of a separatist movement and charged him with treason after he reportedly declined to travel to Saudi Arabia for talks.
